title: fix(cli): os generate writes the starter's style; named views, a flowless action, the dashboard's nav entry, topic help
body:
Part of #32153 — this PR delivers the `packages/cli` half (generator style, `os g view` naming, `os g action` default, the `os g dashboard` navigation line, topic help). Two items of the card stay open on it: the `field-no-consumers` alignment (`packages/lint`, spec lane; measured below, not edited here) and the empty state a dashboard with no widgets should draw (a renderer change under `ui/`, out of this PR's scope; the generator cannot provide one, see Acceptance notes).

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os generate` 生成的对象改用 starter 的写法（`Field.*`、具名导出、字段分组）；`os g view` 可用 `--object` 给视图单独起名；无 flow 时 `os g action` 生成声明式 update 动作而非拒绝；`os g dashboard` 打印要加进应用导航的那一行；`os --help` 的主题说明描述主题本身。
- 为什么改：新手和照抄 CLI 输出的编码 agent 在最初十分钟里会遇到两种写法、三次拒绝和一个打开后空白的看板。
- 风险与回滚：只改 CLI 生成器与帮助文案，已生成的文件不受影响；`os g object` 改写为 starter 写法（仍保留默认导出，默认导入照常可用）。两处放宽：`os g view NAME --object OBJECT` 与无 flow 时的 `os g action NAME --object OBJECT` 原先被拒绝，现在写出命名列表视图与声明式 update 动作；唯一的行为收紧是对已有视图容器的对象再 `os g view` 时提前拒绝（原本写完后配置加载失败）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts`（`resolveScaffoldBindings` 的 flag-or-none 分支与一对象一容器拒绝；action 模板的 update 分支）、`packages/cli/package.json`（`oclif.topics`）、`packages/cli/test/generate-scaffold-gates.e2e.test.ts`（新 describe）。
- 两分钟验证：在全新 `os init` 项目里依次运行 `os g object ticket`、`os g view open_tickets --object ticket`、`os g action resolve --object ticket`、`os g dashboard overview`，再 `os validate` 与 `os lint`：四步都退出 0，两个门禁零发现，最后一步打印一行 `{ id: '…_overview_dashboard_nav', type: 'dashboard', … }` 并点名 starter 应用。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Every behaviour change, FROM → TO. Every existing invocation keeps working; one (`os g view` for an object that already has a container) is now refused before writing instead of writing a file the config then refuses.

- **`os g object NAME`** — FROM a raw `{ type: 'text', … }` field literal, a default export only and no field groups TO the `npm create objectstack` starter's style (`note.object.ts`): the field through `Field.text({ … })`, placed in a declared `fieldGroups` section (`details`), and the object exported by name (`export const NAME = ObjectSchema.create({ … })`). The barrel line it appends re-exports that name (`export { NAME } from './NAME.object'`). `export default` stays beside the named export, so a default import of a generated object (the `os init` starter app's shape) keeps working. The binding stays `toCamelCase(NAME)`, so no refusal layer moves (`os g object class` is still refused, measured by `generate-refuses-unparseable-name.test.ts`).
- **`os g view NAME --object OBJECT`** — FROM refused (`--object` was not taken; the name was always read as the object's) TO a views container for OBJECT whose one list view is the named entry `listViews.NAME`, served as `OBJECT.NAME` (`expandViewContainer`). `os g view OBJECT` without `--object` writes what it always wrote.
- **`os g view` for an object that already has a views container** — FROM writing the file, after which the config no longer loaded (`defineStack`: "View container '…' is declared twice in `views`", measured on this head) TO refused before anything is written, printing the `listViews` entry to add to the existing container instead. This is the one invocation whose outcome changes; it never produced a loading config.
- **`os g action NAME --object OBJECT` in a stack that declares no flow** — FROM refused ("an action runs a flow") TO a declarative update action: `operation: 'update'` with a `params` entry naming the object's title field (else its first field), on `record_header`. `--flow`, or one flow in the stack, still writes the flow action; several flows and no `--flow`, or an unknown `--flow`, are still refused. An object with no field is refused (an update with nothing to write is refused by `ActionSchema`).
- **`os g dashboard NAME`** — the dashboard is still written with `widgets: []`; its header and the command's output now name the app navigation entry that lists it and the stack's app to add it to (an `app` package holds at most one app, ADR-0019 D3, so the remedy is an entry in that app, never a second app; with no app it names `os g app`). `os g` edits no app.
- **`os --help`** — FROM each topic line showing one of its commands' descriptions (`data  Create a new record`, `meta  Delete a metadata item`, `db  Reclaim SQLite free space…`) TO a description of the topic, declared under `oclif.topics` in `packages/cli/package.json`.
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (the `os generate` section) says the same.

## Tests

- `generate-scaffold-validates.test.ts` (per PR, in process) — a new describe: the object's style, the declarative action, the named view and the dashboard's navigation entry each pass `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` with zero findings; the roster-wide zero-findings pin still covers every generator's default invocation.
- `generate-binds-from-stack.test.ts` — `--object` on a view, the one-container refusal (named and legacy spelling), the flowless action and its refusals.
- `generate-emission-parses.test.ts`, `generate-refuses-unparseable-name.test.ts` — the barrel line now comes from the command's own `barrelExportLine`, and the unparseable-name refusals are unmoved.
- `help-topic-descriptions.test.ts` (new) — every topic directory without an index command declares a description, none is stale, none repeats a command's.
- `generate-scaffold-gates.e2e.test.ts` (nightly tier) — a new top-level describe runs the real commands on a fresh `os init` project: the four variants exit 0, then `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint --json` report zero findings, and `os g view all_items --object item` (the starter object already has a container) exits 1 with nothing written.

## Acceptance notes

- **`field-no-consumers` (card item 5) — measured, not edited (`packages/lint`, spec lane).** On a fresh `os init` project after `os g object ticket` + `os g view open_tickets --object ticket`: adding `description: Field.textarea({ label: 'Description' })` with no `group` makes `os validate` warn `object "…_ticket" · field "description": declared, but nothing in this stack displays or reads it (inert; …)`, rule `field-no-consumers`; the same field with `group: 'details'` is silent. The rule credits a keyed field group as displayed and does not count the default create form or the record page's remaining-fields section. The generated object now carries a `details` group and the comment telling the author to give each added field a `group`, so the generator no longer leads into the warning; the rule's own alignment is the spec lane's.
- **Empty dashboard (card item 4, second half).** `DashboardSchema` has no dashboard-level empty-state key, and `DashboardRenderer` draws nothing for `widgets: []` (its own comment: "a dashboard with no widgets at all draws no refusal"). A generator-written `description` would be shown to every viewer after widgets exist, so the generator writes the empty-state guidance as a comment above `widgets` instead. The drawn empty state is a renderer change under `ui/`.
- The `os init` app template's own object (`init.ts`) still writes raw `{ type: … }` literals and a default export; `os g object` now matches the `npm create objectstack` starter, which the card and the getting-started docs name. Noted, not changed (outside this PR's file surface).
- Resumed run: the branch's three earlier commits were re-read hunk by hunk and kept; this run added the `os init` end-to-end describe and re-ran every verification on the merged head.

## Verification

All readings on `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, head `5bbc1c0c6a` (the branch merged with `origin/main` `26f4e6d84a`) unless named otherwise. `packages/cli` build closure rebuilt on this head, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exit 0.

<details><summary>CLI tests (unit layer, the changed files, the nightly e2e)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` on `f527dc766e` (same diff, before the last two `main` merges): Test Files 413 passed (413), Tests 5898 passed (5898); lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- The five changed per-PR files on `5bbc1c0c6a` (`help-topic-descriptions`, `generate-binds-from-stack`, `generate-emission-parses`, `generate-scaffold-validates` in `unit`; `generate-refuses-unparseable-name` in `integration`): Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 121 passed (121).
- `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly … vitest run test/generate-scaffold-gates.e2e.test.ts` on `5bbc1c0c6a`: Tests 4 failed | 52 passed (56). The new `os init` describe: 11 of 11 passed. The 4 failures are pre-existing legs, reproduced with `generate.ts` swapped back to the merge base's blob (`a4ff34c3f8`; restore proved by blob == HEAD `b16e397ad5` and an empty `git diff HEAD`):
  - `os g app gate_probe --object gate_target` exits 1 on a fresh `npm create objectstack` starter: the starter now ships `main.app.ts`, so a second app is refused (`An 'app' package must define at most one app`, ADR-0019 D3). The leg's expectation predates the starter app.
  - `os g permission gate_probe --object gate_target`, then `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`: one finding `nav-object-ungranted@apps[0].navigation[0].objectName`, on the starter app's Notes entry.
  Both are reported to the seat; neither generator is touched here.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` on `5bbc1c0c6a`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck: OK`).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one generator's style change, once)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts --anchor '    name: Field.text({' --replacement "    name: ({ type: 'text' as const," -- vitest run test/generate-scaffold-validates.test.ts` on `7a6da2b47e` (the test imports `../src/commands/generate.js`, no `dist/` in the path):

- landed: anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1, blob `b16e397ad589` → `cf3a1deb36fc`;
- mutant: Tests 1 failed | 25 passed (26) — the failure is the style pin, `expected 'import { ObjectSchema, Field } …' to match /name: Field\.text\(\{/`; the roster's zero-findings pins stay green (the raw literal is valid metadata), so the style pin is the one that holds this;
- restored: blob == HEAD `b16e397ad589`, `git diff HEAD` empty; re-run Tests 26 passed (26).

</details>

<details><summary>Fresh `os init` project, by hand (the e2e describe's commands)</summary>

`os init gates-init -t app --no-install`; bare `os validate --json` and `os lint --json`: exit 0, zero findings. Then `os g object ticket`, `os g view open_tickets --object ticket`, `os g action resolve --object ticket` (prints `Flow: none (this stack declares no flow: a declarative update; --flow runs one)`), `os g dashboard overview` (prints the entry and `Add this entry to the navigation of app 'gates_init_main_app'`): each exit 0. Then `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint --json`: each exit 0, zero findings. `os g view all_items --object item`: exit 1, `src/views` unchanged.

`defineStack` with two views containers for one object, measured on this head: refused, `View container 'xy_t' is declared twice in views`.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on `5bbc1c0c6a`: 117 commands; all run, each exit captured before any pipe; 116 exit 0. `pnpm check:type-check-debt`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (the verify lock's queue-timeout) — NOT MEASURED on this head; on `7a6da2b47e` under the lock it was exit 0 (`check-type-check-coverage --re-measure: OK`). `--ran` reconciliation: `117 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 116 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide, `eslint . --no-inline-config`) on `7a6da2b47e`: exit 0; the one file changed after it (`generate-scaffold-gates.e2e.test.ts`) and `generate.ts`, re-linted on `5bbc1c0c6a`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0, no anchored file in the change set.
- CI families: read from this PR's check-runs.

</details>
